title: Sections of a constant sheaf on an irreducible space
statement: Let X be an irreducible topological space and A an abelian group. On the site of open subsets of X with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let A_X be the constant abelian sheaf, namely the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value A [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For every nonempty open subset U of X, the sections A_X(U) are canonically A, and for nonempty opens V subseteq U the restriction map A_X(U) \to A_X(V) is the identity under these identifications.

source.place: Definition 006W (definition-constant-sheaf), together with the locally constant-map description of the associated sheaf

proof.text: Each open subspace U is preirreducible by Opens.isOpenEmbedding' and Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.preirreducibleSpace. Mathlib gives PreconnectedSpace U [lem-pc-irreducible-space-connected]; for a nonempty U choose a point x_U.

Apply [lem-sc-constant-sheaf-locally-constant-comparison] to obtain additive equivalences c_U from constant-sheaf sections to LocallyConstant U A, together with their pointwise restriction identity. This is precisely the sheafification comparison from the previous plan, now isolated as a reusable statement without irreducibility.

For nonempty U, evaluation f ↦ f(x_U) is an additive equivalence LocallyConstant U A ≃ A with inverse the constant map. Mathlib LocallyConstant.eq_const proves the left inverse using [lem-weil-pbc-connected-locally-constant-map]; the right inverse and additivity are definitional. Compose c_U with this equivalence.

For V ⊆ U nonempty, use the comparison restriction identity to evaluate the restricted section at x_V as evaluation of c_U(s) at the image of x_V in U. LocallyConstant.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace identifies this value with c_U(s)(x_U). Function extensionality proves the required equality of restriction maps.
